name: Xichang LC-3
best_known_for: First Chinese GTO success (1984) + comsat workhorse
credit: Fleet launch-site entry added during the cross-correlation analysis (#306 follow-up). XSC LC-3 hosted the first Long March 3 launch attempt on 1984-01-29 (partial failure, third-stage re-ignition) and the first successful flight on 1984-04-08 (first Chinese GTO success), then many subsequent Apstar / Asiasat / Sinosat missions.
